card.name: Linking words before abstract destination nouns
card.fires_on: Small linking words (of, to, into, toward, in) or verbs like spreading and establish, just before an abstract goal such as Islam, communism, peace, adulthood or order. Seen in general history and society text.

modes.label: Of/toward before an ideology or religion
modes.description: A link word comes right before a belief system or political system.
modes.example: At Mecca, the chief shrine<< of>> Islam, he took the title of cal

modes.label: Into/in before life stage
modes.description: A link word leads into adulthood or adult life.
modes.example: their ADD/ADHD will continue<< into>> adulthood. Children that suffer from this condition

modes.label: Verb of spreading or establishing
modes.description: A verb of spreading or setting up comes before an abstract object.
modes.example: The Soviet Union’s aspiration of<< spreading>> Communism throughout the world was a fact
